---
title: "JVM Topics"
description: "Understand JVM concepts through running examples and the Java platform specification."
---

The **Java Virtual Machine (JVM)** provides the runtime environment for Java bytecode. This section groups JVM-related concepts and their practical implications.

## Topics

- [Java Memory Model (JMM)](jmm/index.qmd) — The rules governing how threads observe shared memory, including visibility, ordering, and happens-before.

## Planned topics

- Class loading, linking, and initialisation
- JVM runtime data areas
- Heap management and garbage collection
- JIT compilation and runtime optimisation

**Terminology:** The Java Memory Model is defined by the Java Language Specification and applies to Java concurrency semantics; it should not be confused with the physical JVM memory layout (heap, stacks, and other runtime data areas).
